KJV.text: Then should I yet have comfort; yea, I would harden myself in sorrow: let him not spare; for I have not concealed the words of the Holy One.
KJV.displayText: Then should I yet have comfort; yea, I would harden myself in sorrow: let him not spare; for I have not concealed the words of the Holy One.

BSB.text: It still brings me comfort, and joy through unrelenting pain, that I have not denied the words of the Holy One.

CPDV.text: And may this be my consolation, that in afflicting me with sorrow, although he might not be lenient with me, I still do not contradict the words of the Holy One.

verses.context: Answering his friend Eliphaz, the suffering Job wishes God would end his life, and names the one comfort he still has in his pain.
